themes.evidence: Our innovative, collaborative efforts yield products that improve quality of life globally while producing economic benefits with far-reaching influence.
Across our 17 countries of operations, over 11,600 people work in a truly integrated way to find and produce oil and natural gas.

linguistic_shift: The number of countries and people has decreased from 21 and 15,600 to 17 and 11,600, respectively, but the overall tone remains consistent.
